title: Materials for Sustainability
description: Systematic approach to materials selection for engineering design; design requirements and objectives; data-driven design tools; materials design concepts (materials performance index, eco-audit). Sustainable development trade-offs; economic, environmental and social capital. Project-based learning approach; team project to propose a new technology; United Nations (UN) sustainable development goals.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of MECH 424, MECH 450A (if taken in the same topic), MECH 450F (if taken in the same topic).
